investment_conditions.description: Mandatory for all industrial units prior to initiating site work or construction.

employee_conditions.description: All unit sizes categorized under Red, Orange, or Green pollution classifications.

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) including manufacturing process flow
Site Layout Plan and industrial area zoning certificate
Water balance sheet showing daily fresh water intake and trade effluent generation
Effluent Treatment Plant (ETP) / Sewage Treatment Plant (STP) design proposal
Air pollution control measures for boilers, generators, and chimney stacks
Land ownership deed / MIDC possession letter
description: Mandatory statutory clearance to establish any industrial plant, discharge effluent, or emit air pollutants under state environmental legislation.
source: Water (Prevention & Control of Pollution) Act 1974, Section 25 & Air Act 1981, Section 21 - MPCB Citizen Charter

department: Chief Fire Officer (CFO) / Maharashtra Fire Services

investment_conditions.description: Required for all industrial building plan approvals.

required_documents: Architectural drawings showing building elevations, sections, and site layout
Fire fighting and suppression schematic drawings (hydrants, sprinklers, alarms)
Setback distances and access road widths for fire tenders (minimum 6m)
Water storage capacity details for static firefighting tanks
MIDC / Local planning authority building plan scrutiny receipt
description: Preliminary approval confirming that the proposed factory layout and building architecture conform to national and state fire safety codes.
source: Maharashtra Fire Prevention and Life Safety Measures Act 2006 & NBC 2016 Part 4

investment_conditions.description: All manufacturing premises engaging 10+ workers with power or 20+ without.

employee_conditions.description: Threshold trigger: 10 or more workers with power or 20 or more without power.

required_documents: Form No. 1 (Application for permission to construct, extend, or take into use any building as a factory)
Flowchart of the manufacturing process with material safety data sheets (if chemical / boiler)
Detailed plant layout showing machinery spacing, gangways, emergency exits, and ventilation
Structural stability certificate signed by a competent structural engineer
Proof of ownership / lease of factory premises
description: Statutory pre-construction vetting of occupational safety, emergency exits, ventilation, and machinery spacing under the Factories Act.
source: Factories Act 1948, Section 6 & Maharashtra Factory Rules 1963, Rule 3

department: Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI)

investment_conditions.description: Applies to all food businesses producing, processing, or packaging food products.

employee_conditions.description: Mandatory for all food processing units regardless of workforce size.

required_documents: Layout plan of the processing unit showing dimensions and operational areas
List of Directors / Partners / Proprietor with full contact details and photo ID
List of machinery & equipment with installed production capacity
Water testing analysis report from an authorized / NABL accredited laboratory
Source of raw materials and food safety management system (FSMS) plan
NOC / Proof of possession of premises (Rent agreement / Lease deed / MIDC allotment)
description: Statutory license required before commencing manufacturing, processing, or packaging of any food product under the Food Safety and Standards Act.
source: Food Safety and Standards Act 2006, Section 31 & Licensing Regulations 2011
